results.author: Peng 沈鹏
results.text:
Quick confession 🙋‍♂️ I haven't taken a single meeting note in 3 months.
Not because I stopped caring.
I just noticed something — while I was busy writing down what you said 30 seconds ago, I was missing what you're saying right now .
For me, note-taking was never really listening.

results.author: Alex Prompter
results.text:
Gemini 3.8 just made manual admin work pointless.

It reads photos, PDFs, invoices and receipts for less than a cent per task.

Here are 10 prompts to automate the back-office work you're still doing by hand:

results.author: Alex Prompter
results.text:
6. Supplier price check

"You are my procurement analyst. I'll upload my last supplier invoice. For every line item, search current market pricing and show me: what I paid, the going rate, and the difference as a percentage. Rank by how much I'm overpaying in real money per year.

results.author: Alex Prompter
results.text:
7. Meeting notes to actions

"You are my chief of staff. I'll paste raw meeting notes or a transcript. Extract every commitment made, who owns it, and the deadline. Separate mine from other people's. Flag anything agreed without an owner. Then draft the follow-up email confirming
